## Summary

**Story #1 — JSON REST API for user accounts and personal notes (ESM, on-disk store)**
- URL: https://github.com/dsj1984/bench-sbx-2026-08-07-story-scope-mandrel-a42832b4/issues/1
- Status: `agent::ready` · cohort label `plan-run::cc3ce080`

**Mode:** seed (ideation from prose). Authored as a single cohesive Story per the default-single split policy — the endpoints, the bearer-token auth flow, and the on-disk persistence are one contract.

**Contract captured in the Spec + 8 acceptance criteria:**
- `node:http` only, **no external web framework**; ESM; `PORT` default 3000; JSON in/out.
- Endpoints: `POST /signup` (201 → `{id,username}`, dup → 409), `POST /login` (200 → `{session}`, bad creds → 401), `GET /me` (bearer-authed), `POST /notes` / `GET /notes` (authed, owner-scoped).
- Persistence to an on-disk store (`node:sqlite` `DatabaseSync` under `--experimental-sqlite`, or an fs-backed equivalent) with an explicit restart-survival criterion.
- Inviolable security invariants folded in: hashed passwords (scrypt + per-user salt, no plaintext), parameterized queries, responses exclude hashes/salts, no secrets in logs, basic auth-endpoint rate limit.
- Sensible bad-request handling (400/404/405, no crash) and an npm `start` script.

**Key default decisions (headless, no operator):** store engine = `node:sqlite` (fs-JSON equivalent permitted); hashing = `crypto.scryptSync`; opaque bearer tokens with no explicit expiry; and the task's Authorization-header contract deliberately governs over the security baseline's cookie-storage default — all recorded in the Story's Key Assumptions.

Critics: consolidation and pre-mortem both `dispatch: false`; text-hygiene clean. Per instructions, I ran the planning pipeline only — no delivery. To build it: `/deliver 1`.

**What shipped** (dependency-free `node:http` ESM service, fs-backed persistent store):
- `server.js` — router + JSON body parsing, `POST /signup`·`/login`, `GET /me`, `POST`·`GET /notes`, PORT env (default 3000), auth rate-limiting, 400/401/404/405/409 handling that never crashes on bad input
- `src/auth.js` — scrypt hashing with per-user salt, high-entropy `crypto.randomBytes` session tokens, bearer extraction
- `src/store.js` — atomic temp+rename JSON persistence, idempotent first-run schema creation, server-side note ownership scoping
- `test/api.test.js` — 13 tests (unit hash/verify, contract flow, ownership isolation, error paths, **restart persistence**), all green
- `package.json` — added `"start": "node server.js"`; `.gitignore` — store data ignored

**Verification run:** `npm test` 13/13 pass, `npm run lint` (node --check) clean, and a live `npm start` e2e confirmed signup→login→/me→create/list notes, cross-user isolation (u2 saw `[]`), 401 unauthed, and PORT override.

Single-Story run, so the per-run epilogue (N>1) is correctly skipped. No recalled memory was invalidated by this change. One security note worth surfacing: the plan deliberately uses `Authorization: Bearer` tokens over the security-baseline's httpOnly-cookie default — an explicit, planned carve-out stated in the Story's `## Spec` for this REST API. All other security MUSTs (scrypt+salt, no plaintext, no secret logging, rate-limiting, sensitive-field exclusion) are honored.
